design_text: Down on the floor of this tank lives a family of twelve hundred and fifty-two creatures, and nearly every one of them is nothing but a stomach. Each is a single box of tissue that eats the marine snow, the dead stuff drifting down. All of them come from one creature that dropped in from outside.

descriptions.M1: British accent. Deep baritone voice. A man in his sixties. Chesty and resonant, with a hushed intimacy. A warm, resonant voice with clear, natural diction. Calm and quietly authoritative, with genuine curiosity and a subtle sense of wonder. Speak at an unhurried pace, using varied sentence rhythms and thoughtful pauses that give the viewer time to absorb the images. Convey emotion through delicate shifts in tone and emphasis. The delivery feels intimate and conversational, as though sharing a remarkable discovery with one person.
